# Vimeo Video Downloader

> Browser-based Vimeo video downloader for public Vimeo links. Paste a Vimeo URL, choose the resolution you need, and save the MP4 locally without installing an app or creating an account.

## Core Product

- [Vimeo Video Downloader Home](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/): Main Vimeo download entry with link parsing, resolution selection, and troubleshooting for links that cannot be parsed.
- [Vimeo Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/vimeo-downloader/): Dedicated Vimeo downloader landing page with the supported link formats and download steps.
- [Pricing](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/pricing/): Buy one-time Credits for website downloads, or review the Unlimited plan for the browser extension.
- [About Vimeo Video Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/about/): Product identity, website and extension responsibilities, privacy principles, and access boundaries.
- [Contact Vimeo Video Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/contact/): Public support channel for account, download, extension, billing, and privacy questions.
- [Full content index](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/llms-full.txt): Complete AI-readable page index including language entrances, technical indexes, and update pages.

## Download Tools

- [Vimeo Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/vimeo-downloader/): Parse public Vimeo video links on vimeo.com, www.vimeo.com, and player.vimeo.com, then download the available renditions.

## Updates

- [Changelog](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/changelog/): Product release notes for Vimeo download support, larger file handling, and product updates.
- [Sitemap](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for canonical pages and per-language sitemap files.

## Key Facts

- Product name: Vimeo Video Downloader.
- Site domain: vimeo-video-downloader.example.
- Platform type: Browser website for public Vimeo links; the browser extension adds larger and queued downloads.
- Supported source platform: Vimeo only (vimeo.com, www.vimeo.com, player.vimeo.com).
- Default language: English.
- Language coverage: 14 website locales.
- Safety boundary: Vimeo Video Downloader never asks for Vimeo or Google passwords, verification codes, API credentials, or session files.
